stem_book: In the trigonometric equation of the form a sin x + b cos x = c, the expression √(a² + b²) is equal to: (a) The LCM of a and b (b) The period of the function (c) The amplitude of the expression (d) A trigonometric identity
key: c The amplitude of the expression
derived: c The amplitude of the expression
correct_answer: c The amplitude of the expression
work: a sin x + b cos x = √(a²+b²) sin(x + φ) ⇒ √(a²+b²) is the amplitude
